Sheaffer Lifetime Desk Fountain Pen
Vintage Desk Pen and Marble Stand Set
14K Gold Nib, Striped Celluloid, Mid-20th Century
A classic Sheaffer Lifetime desk fountain pen set, representing the pinnacle of mid-century executive office stationery. This set features the renowned Sheaffer's Lifetime 14K yellow gold nib, celebrated for its durability and smooth writing characteristics. The pen is paired with a heavy, rectangular black marble base featuring elegant natural gold-toned mineral veining, creating a sophisticated display piece for a desk or study.
Sheaffer's Lifetime 14K gold nib with hallmark and "Made in U.S.A." engraving
Striped celluloid pen barrel with a long, tapered tail for desk use
Heavy black marble base with gold veining and a swivel brass-tone pen socket
Base measurements: 6 inches (L) x 4 inches (W); Pen length: approximately 6.5 inches
Condition:
14K gold nib appears straight with sharp engravings; internal ink mechanism is untested and may require servicing for functional use. The striped celluloid barrel is intact with no cracks, showing light surface scuffing consistent with age. Metal bands show minor tarnishing. The marble base is in good structural condition with no major chips or cracks. The green felt protective pad on the underside is present but shows partial detachment at one corner.

Collection of seven 1980s 45 RPM singles with original picture sleeves, featuring a great mix of rock and pop favorites from the decade.
Includes:
Bruce Springsteen Cover Me / Jersey Girl (live)
Bruce Springsteen Brilliant Disguise / Lucky Man
Elton John I Guess That’s Why They Call It the Blues / The Retreat
Chaka Khan I Feel for You / Chinatown
Crowded House Don’t Dream It’s Over
Tiffany I Think We’re Alone Now
Band Aid Do They Know It’s Christmas? / Feed the World
An appealing group of recognizable 1980s hits highlighted by two Bruce Springsteen singles, including Cover Me backed with the live recording of Jersey Girl. The Band Aid single features the famous 1984 all-star charity collaboration, while Chaka Khan, Elton John, Crowded House and Tiffany round out this nostalgic collection.
All seven records retain their colorful period picture sleeves. Sleeves show varying degrees of vintage handling and age-related wear, including edge and corner wear, creasing and surface wear as visible in the photos. Records have not been professionally graded. Please review photos for individual condition.
